primitives.name: Princeton Winning Run Derivation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Archer followed with another single, on which Winton took third and scored what proved to be the winning run, while the next batter was striking out.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: P_{winning\_run} - probability of a single producing a winning run (dimensionless), P(Winton|single) - conditional probability of Winton advancing to home given a single (dimensionless), P(\Delta R = 1) - probability of exactly one run scoring (dimensionless).
